Very simple way to make football more realistic, so that we don't have games ending Fiji 10-9 France.

Team stats:

  • Offense (1-5, with 1 being Fernando Torres and 5 being very good)
  • Defense (1-5, with 1 being David Luis and 5 being very good)

Goals scored by team, based on team offense - opponent defense stat; if negative, treat as 0.

  • -4 = 1d12-10
  • -3 = 1d11-9
  • -2 = 1d5-3
  • -1 = 1d3-1
  • +0 = 1d4-1
  • +1 = 1d2+1
  • +2 = 2d2
  • +3 = 1d4+1
  • +4 = 2d2+1
  • +5 = 2d2+2
  • +6 = 5d2

 

Let's say we have Italy playing Tuvalu. Italy's offense is a 3 and their defense is a 5. Tuvalu's offense is a 1 and their defense is a 1.

Italy's goal mod is therefore +2, giving them a goal roll of 2d2. Tuvalu's goal mod is -4 giving them a roll of 1d12-10.

Italy rolls 4. Tuvalu rolls -4. Italy 4-0 Tuvalu.

 

Example 2. Germany plays USA. Germany's stats are 4/4. USA's stats are 3/3.

Germany goal mod +1 (1d2+1)

USA goal mod -1 (1d3-1)

Germany 2-1 USA

 

Bonus: Exceptional performance Each team has a chance of performing beyond their normal expectations, gaining a +1 d2 to their goal modifier (thus giving them a better roll). 1d20, if 19 or 20, the team has an exceptional performance. The host nation also has an exceptional performance on a roll of 18.

Example 3. Kiribati plays Ukraine. Kiribati 1/1. Ukraine 3/2.

Kiribati rolls a 20, and has an exceptional game (+1d2 -> +1). Their offense is treated as +0 instead of -1.

Kiribati rolls 1d4-1 (3)

Ukraine rolls 2d2 (2)

Kiribati 3-2 Ukraine
